name: Eastward Ho! (Fowler's moraine on Pleasant Bay, restored heath)
note: Course theme palette (<= 32 colours; same keys as pnw.json plus F0-F2). Eastward Ho! Country Club, Chatham, from the developer's photos (release assorted-lidar-data, eastward.1-5) and NAIP: bright, firm fairways and greens; beyond a mown band, the restored native heath of little bluestem and fescue in straw, olive and copper (F0-F2); pale Cape sand; the bright blue of Pleasant Bay and Crows Pond; dark pitch-pine and oak scrub ground (G0-G2); grassy Chatham lawns and woods out of bounds (L0-L2). Trees in assets-src/trees_eastward_ho.py: pitch pine, red cedar, scrub oak and bayberry. Shadows are a 35% black overlay on top of these.
